content.title: Chapter 70 - PERSONNEL RULES — Sec. 70-62. - Longevity pay.
content.summary:
Certain employees hired prior to December 31, 1978, are entitled to longevity pay.
               Such pay is recognized and ratified for these employees. The city manager may establish
               administrative procedures for the administration of this compensation.
(
Ord. No. 4862
, § 1, 10-16…
